distribution_metadata.name: matrouter
distribution_metadata.summary: Agent-native routing and provenance-preserving aggregation substrate for materials data.

retrieval_strategy.primary_aggregate: one aggregate_source_records call using bounded parallel cross-source execution with at most eight workers and stable-order aggregation; per-source pagination remains sequential and the public 512-item/16-MB Bundle capacity is shared by execution route

stage_2_targets.scientific_role: Preregistered 2D p-6m2 PBE+SOC source-summary band-gap and context record; C2DB exposes no band-structure or DOS artifact route for this record.
stage_2_targets.selection_timing: Fixed before the live run from the declared scientific role and source context; never replaced dynamically.

stage_2_targets.scientific_role: Preregistered bulk P6_3/mmc (space group 194) exact electronic-artifact demonstration target.
stage_2_targets.selection_timing: Fixed before the live run from the declared scientific role and source context; never replaced dynamically.

stage_2_targets.scientific_role: Preregistered exact AFLOW 3D periodic six-site structure for one transparent structural comparison with Materials Project mp-2815; other structures are outside this method input.
stage_2_targets.selection_timing: Fixed before the live run from the declared exact structural comparison; never replaced dynamically.

retrieval_strategy.stage_2_selection_rule: only exact targets preregistered before the live run; target prerequisite searches and artifact acquisitions are follow-up Bundles, not route-coverage runs, and no target is dynamically replaced

requirements.label: mos2-band-gap-all-qualified-source-records
requirements.evidence_use: Acquire the one primary all-qualified cross-source source-record Bundle through MatRouter's logical all-route fan-out.

limitations: source_id is the AFLOW aurl; auid-to-entry reverse resolution is not implemented.
Band/DOS parsing prefers AFLOW processed artifacts and uses the documented EIGENVAL fallback; other raw VASP files require a specialist parser.

rationale: Configured-ready routes precede routes that require configuration.
When prefer_no_api_key is true, all-public routes precede routes requiring credentials.
The declared target source order breaks remaining source-family ties.
Canonical qualified-source identity is the ascending total-order tie-break.
limitations: Ranking is deterministic candidate metadata, not an optimal scientific plan.
